page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. It features 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a 2.0 GB per core allocation. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance consistently in the average performance tier across various workloads. It achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1574.0 and a multi-core score of 5909.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 11379.24. In memory bandwidth tests, it reaches 419.97 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 60.18 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. For specialized tasks, it processes 8.0 million Redis SET operations per second and delivers a static web serving throughput of 11.83 GB/sec.

While the server handles lightweight LLM inference efficiently, processing 764.59 tokens per second for a 135M model, it exhibits poor performance on larger models, dropping to 15.94 tokens per second for a 7B model. Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and lack of local storage, this instance is optimized for compute-heavy tasks that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk I/O. It is well-suited for workloads such as web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations.
